correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 follows by standardization of subsequences; Lemma 2 is certified by exhaustive, independent full support enumerations at n=4 (no three-query supports) and n=6 (no four-query supports). At most one degree-two vertex in any shattered support graph implies 2k-1 distinct positions, giving the all-n upper bound. Explicit ordered-value block constructions realize every binary trace of a k-query witness at n=2k-1 and every larger n. For n=6 a 32-leaf tree and the 58-concept bound give Littlestone dimension exactly five. Standalone program paths are named in RESULT.md; no extrapolation of finite computations substitutes for the all-n argument.
